message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), the U.S. dollar trades roughly at **£0.78–£0.80 per US $**. Using that range:

| USD | Approximate GBP |
|-----|-----------------|
| $20 | £15.60 – £16.00 |

So you can expect about **£15.50–£16.00** for $20, but check a reliable financial news source or your bank’s currency converter for the exact figure at the time of your transaction.
